managed_files.class: shared save file also referenced by another account

coverage.relation_dispositions: 50/50 explicitly classified and compared to ORM metadata plus live PostgreSQL test-schema introspection.
coverage.populated_relation_fixtures: Every user-FK column receives a synthetic row. The departing account has the child role. The collection relation additionally seeds a public collection and a private collection owned by the departing account; deletion retains the public collection/item with no owner and deletes the private collection/item.
coverage.shared_and_other_account_data: The broader focused tests preserve household chat and custom emoji, shared save bytes, and a surviving account API token, login session, and linked-store credential.
coverage.follow_up: R1994 corrects the earlier R1989 game_collections.owner_user_id CASCADE classification. R1990 ORM cascade corrections remain included. Deployed-schema comparison and restore/restart qualification remain open.

verification.result: passed: 19 tests in 112.51 seconds on Python 3.14.10 and PostgreSQL 17.6; the focused run includes the full 50-relation child-account deletion fixture plus retained-content and collection policy assertions.
verification.schema: Fresh uniquely named PostgreSQL test database upgraded through e1f2a3b4c5d6.
verification.cleanup: The disposable test database was dropped after the passing run.
verification.discovered_fixes: The full relation fixture reproduced ORM attempts to null non-nullable CASCADE foreign keys for play_sessions.user_id, both user_friendships user references, detail_layout_presets.user_id, and saved_filters.user_id. Their ORM backrefs now defer deletion to the declared database CASCADE.
